title: rl-engine extraction plan
summary: Adopted master design plan for the rl-engine roguelike engine: numbered architectural decisions, crate layout, provenance, exclusions, open questions, milestones and a dated progress log.
notes: Not a single-decision ADR: a consolidated decision log (section 3 Decisions, 3.1-3.13) plus crate layout, milestones (section 8) and a long progress log. Header reads 'Status: adopted, revised 2026-09-09; being built', treated as Accepted so decisions are locked. Competing signals: SPEC (crate layout, conventions) and PRD-like milestones; ADR chosen per ambiguity rule and because section 3 is explicitly titled Decisions. Progress log entries record later revisions to some decisions (e.g. crate merges into rl-rules, EnginePlugins removed), so the synthesizer should prefer the most recent progress entry where it conflicts with section 3 text. Filename hash suffix is a placeholder: no shell was available to compute SHA-256 of the source path.
